hold_text: Tier-2 close-path label change (order_monitor snapshot reconciler close + a new Alpaca order read); the manager merges and deploys (trader restart; web-api picks up the KPI predicate on its next restart).
why: WHY: manager decision 2026-11-19 ~23:54Z on row VENUE-FLAT-PENDING-ENTRY-LABELS (after PR #27535). alpaca_options_paper SLV trade 8034's DAY mleg entry expired unfilled; the position-snapshot reconciler closed the row exchange_flat_reconciled and mechanics_fault_intake grades that as a close fault. WHAT: at the snapshot flat close, ONLY after _entry_order_hold found the entry order neither working nor unreadable, a new fail-closed venue read (AlpacaClient.order_entry_unfilled via clients.account_entry_order_unfilled) asks whether it ended canceled/expired/rejected with filled_qty exactly 0. Only then is the row closed with the new neutral exit_reason entry_unfilled (package cascade uses the same label); any fill, any read failure, a 404, or an ambiguous status keeps exchange_flat_reconciled. entry_unfilled joins soak_state NEUTRAL_EXITS, real_money_close_attribution NOT_STRATEGY_EXIT and ml_entry_live_monitor OPERATIONAL_EXIT_REASONS (kept equal), gets its own ungraded bucket-B category in paper_record_classifier, is dropped by _clean_trades.exclude_reset_flat_predicate, and is excluded from the local-PnL sweep so no mark-to-market PnL is fabricated. Not changed: the stuck-strategy watchdog close (it also rewrites the package close_reason). Gates this adds or changes: none.
